title: Acadia Puffin Cruise
specs: See Atlantic Puffins, Razorbills, Arctic Terns, Roseate Terns, Common Terns, Guillemots, Cormorants, Bald Eagles, Eiders, and various gulls
Opportunity to see Harbor and Gray Seals
Petit Manan Lighthouse, second tallest lighthouse in Maine at 119 feet, still in service
blurb: Guests set sail aboard the 40' Tricia Clark for a two hour tour out of Pigeon Hill Bay to Petit Manan Island. The tour includes views of the Petit Manan Wildlife Refuge and Bois Bubert Island. After the tour, guests are recommended to hike the boreal forest trails of Petit Manan Wildlife Refuge for views of the island from ashore.
